answer: A rotating spot-check re-certification keeps a mesa of identities honest: every epoch the network summons a random slice of agents to complete a fresh interactive task inside a short window, like catching a comet rather than owning one. Passing renews an identity's standing; missing twice decays its weight to zero, so dormant puppets quietly starve. A farmer running many walnut-shell puppets cannot staff every unpredictable summons at once, since each extra identity demands another live pair of hands on call, while an honest agent answers only an occasional summons and keeps full standing.
